title: 襪子三雙一百
subject: a night-market sock seller doing a fast patter routine to sell three pairs for a hundred dollars
caption: Mandarin big-band swing pop in the 1940s jump-swing style. Full trumpet, trombone and saxophone sections trading shout riffs; a walking upright bass; swung ride-cymbal drums with rimshot accents; a stride piano comping; a muted trumpet answering the vocal. Roomy vintage big-band hall, brass bright and forward, light room reverb. Male baritone in fast hawker patter on the verses, crooning smoothly on the chorus. 152 BPM, B-flat major. Brassy, cheeky and fast-talking. No electro-swing beats, no trap drums, no autotune, no EDM synths, no ballad tempo.
lyrics:
[Intro - brass shout and drum fill]

[Verse 1]
來喔來喔，走過路過不要錯過
純棉的襪子，穿了腳不臭
黑的白的灰的，還有一雙印恐龍
阿姨你摸摸看，這個彈性像彈簧

[Pre-Chorus]
不是一雙一百，也不是兩雙一百

[Chorus]
三雙一百，三雙一百
穿去上班，穿去約會
破了一個洞，算我的
三雙一百，今天最後一攤

[Verse 2]
年輕人你別走，你的襪子在笑你
大拇指都跑出來，跟我打招呼
買給你爸，買給你男朋友
買了不後悔，後悔我請你吃雞排

[Pre-Chorus]
不要殺價喔，我已經流血了

[Chorus]
三雙一百，三雙一百
穿去上班，穿去約會
快收攤了，算你四雙
四雙一百，只有今天這攤

[Outro - brass tag]
好啦好啦，五雙
不要跟別人說
